title: Ledger Flex from Virgin Megastore, Dubai

purchase.dateNote: Not given. Rewinsky told Mark Karpelès on 16 November 2026 that he bought it at Virgin Megastore in Dubai, a Ledger authorized reseller; the store branch and the purchase date weren't given.

components: Implant board along the edge of the device, next to the hinge of the back cover, with a u.FL connector
Flexible antenna on the inside of the back cover, marked "AC-A2201-FX-…-V1.3", with a coax lead down to the implant board
implant.notes: Rewinsky (@Rewinskyx) posted on 15 November 2026 that 1.3k SOL had been drained from his Ledger, with the transaction on Solscan. The next day he opened the device and wrote that it was tampered with. The photo shows the same kind of antenna as the other Flex implants, stuck to the inside of the back cover, with its coax lead running to an extra board beside the Flex's own NFC coil (EU_NFC_FPC Rev 2.1.0). The marking reads "AC-A2201-FX-…-V1.3" (mirrored in the photo); the Chinese characters in the middle are not clearly legible, but are likely "欧亚版" as on the V1.2 Flex antennas. This is the first V1.3 antenna recorded here on a Ledger (the implant in the Trezor Safe 5 sold by CryptoBilis also has a V1.3 antenna, A2207-N5-欧亚版-V1.3), and it uses "FX" where the earlier Flex antennas read "FLEX". He later told Mark Karpelès that he bought the device at Virgin Megastore in Dubai, a Ledger authorized reseller. It is the first implanted device recorded here from the Middle East.
